headline: Last session: Sensex jumps 900 points and Nifty tops 22,500 as IT stocks lead rebound, snapping losing streak

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 12 October.

why: IT sector led the rebound with a 3% jump in the last session, driven by gains in major stocks like TCS
All sectoral indices turned green, indicating a broad-based recovery across the Indian equity market
The market snapped its biggest weekly losing streak in 25 years, providing a significant relief rally
Strong performance in the FMCG sector, which gained over 2%, contributed to the benchmark's surge
whatHappening: Sensex gained nearly 900 points to close above the 22,500 mark on the last trading day
Elon Musk targeted Ambani over Starlink's entry into India, alleging monopolistic practices in the sector
Netflix is planning a major restructuring that puts approximately 850 jobs at risk globally
The Indian market is currently closed for the weekend and is scheduled to reopen on Monday, 12 October
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmarks surged as the Sensex gained nearly 900 points and Nifty reclaimed the 22,500 level. The rally was driven by a 3% jump in IT stocks and broad-based buying, successfully snapping a historic weekly losing streak. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will reopen for trading on Monday.
